text: The build starts here — connecting to the exact tables Lesson 84's scope actually needs, nothing more.
Nine tables, selected deliberately from the Navigator. Every one traces back to a requirement from Lesson 84 — resist importing the whole database just in case.
Import mode wins here for a specific reason: this project doesn't need real-time data, and Import gives the fastest experience while actively building visuals in the lessons ahead.
One asymmetry worth knowing: cutting an unused column later is cheap. Discovering you never imported a needed one is not. When in doubt, bring it in.
Tables loaded, row counts checked. Lesson 86 is where the real cleanup work begins, in Power Query.
